title: Fixed-size array of counters
summary: Allocate one unsigned integer per possible label and count occurrences by index. Labels must be integers in range and counts must fit in a slot.
triggers: dense integer keys from zero to a known bound
one numeric slot per possible label
prompts: Tally votes for numbered candidates, including those with zero votes.
Each sensor reports a small integer status. Build a histogram in status order.
invariant: After each label, its slot holds the number of occurrences seen so far.
mantra: Use the label as its own index.
pitfalls: Check the lower bound because Python accepts negative indices.

anchors.name: Sort Colors
anchors.trick: A fixed set of labels fits in a small counter array.

complexity.time: O(n + k) for n labels and k slots

mutations.explanation: Overwrites the count when a label appears again.
